text: Yes, the 2023 tree-cover loss on this property is confirmed. Approximately 4.5 hectares of tree cover loss were mapped within the asset in 2023, which is about 0.12% of the total asset area. This loss is corroborated by later observations and agrees with the JRC 2020 reference data. The affected area is primarily planted forest, specifically Pinus elliottii and Pinus taeda. However, the cause of the loss and whether it was legal or authorized is not established by this evidence.
